metadata.name: Cell — reward-free chemotaxis (active inference)
metadata.description: Phase 6.7 — the Cell port of the picrawler reward-free homeokinetic NAVIGATION result, with the SAME brain wiring and only the body morphology swapped. A transparent two-module chain: ScentCompass (perception) subscribes the raw 8-nostril reality.proprio.scent and publishes the egocentric up-gradient bearing percept.scent_compass; ChemotaxisAI (control) steers the two flagella (action.left/right) to drive that bearing's lateral component to zero — Friston active-inference closure, acting to null the agent's own perceived prediction error. NO reward, NO reinforcement, NO reward shaping, NO Premotor, NO NeurochemState. The full perception→action chain (scent sensor → ScentCompass → ChemotaxisAI → Motor L/R) is visible + auditable in the brain graph; nothing crosses the body boundary that isn't a registered raw sensor. The nutrient hits the body counts (Area3D, ground-truth) are the metric, never fed back to the controller. Set body_model=differential_paddler + reflex_modular=true so al/ar are direct per-flagellum thrusts (both→forward, asymmetric→turn).
